title: MultiTransport provider manifest v0
description: Immutable trusted-package manifest of a MultiTransport transport provider (MT-001, design only). This is a syntax/admission-preflight contract: it does NOT verify artifact SHA authenticity, PID ownership, route safety or real E2E operation — those are runtime checks of later milestones (see MULTITRANSPORT-MVP.md). Field evidence (physical tests) lives in acceptance-v0, not here.

provider_id.description: Stable provider identifier; must equal the transport.d directory name.

server_wire.description: Explicit wire-protocol variant identifier. Placeholder or explanatory text is forbidden; different wires are never interchangeable.

server_class.description: Class of compatible server side (e.g. wdtt-exit-vps). Not interchangeable across providers.

capabilities.description: Static code/build levels only. Physical field results belong to acceptance-v0 records; live availability belongs to status-v0.

admission_min_mb.description: Documented admission floor policy. null = no documented floor; starting then requires explicit owner GO. A floor is a policy, not proof of sufficiency for any workload.

admission_source.description: Where the floor comes from (contract/issue/issue-comment reference). Required when admission_min_mb is an integer.

measured.description: Whether real memory measurements exist for this artifact.

measurement_ref.description: Pointer to redacted measurement evidence (e.g. acceptance record id). Required when measured is true.

artifact_path.description: Provider-relative path; path traversal is rejected.

configuration_reference.description: Pointer to the owner-config format documentation/template. The secret config itself is never part of the manifest.

allOf.description: Monotonic invariant: a binary cannot have a feature built in when its sources lack it.

loopbackBind.description: Exactly 127.0.0.1:port (v0 conservative rule; wider 127/8 requires separate justification). Wildcard, LAN, IPv6, 'localhost' and other 127.x addresses are rejected.
